title: AfrPowerOS assertion-level confidence labels
description: Per-claim sourcing and confidence for a single country record. Each material factual claim gets its own source, confidence, and date fields.

field.description: The record field this assertion covers, e.g. 'program_status', 'iaea_milestone_phase', 'vendors'

value.description: The asserted value. String, number, integer, array of strings, or null.

source_url.description: Precise article or document URL supporting this assertion (not a homepage)

observation_date.description: Date the assertion was observed or recorded (YYYY or YYYY-MM)

verification_date.description: Date this assertion was last independently verified (YYYY-MM-DD)
